Our Singapore story. Our Indian chapter.

Everyday essentials.
Handled with care.

With 35+ years of excellence in Singapore and 5+ years in India, Bigfoot brings a Singapore standard of care, reliability and operational discipline to a growing Indian market.

At Bigfoot Cold Storage and Warehouse Services Pvt Ltd in Redhills, Chennai, we combine that experience with local understanding to support temperature-controlled storage, warehousing and logistics.

From packaged spices and bagged rice to other fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), storage and handling need to fit the product. Discuss dry warehousing for ambient goods, or temperature-controlled storage where required, with receiving and onward movement planned together.

  • Modern refrigeration
  • Insulated storage systems
  • Coordinated handling

Good questions.
Helpful answers.

Ask us on WhatsApp ↗
Where is your facility?

Our facility is at No. 13, Rajiv Gandhi Street, Vadakarai, Redhills, Chennai–52, India.

What storage services do you offer?

We offer cold storage, temperature-controlled storage and warehouse management, supported by inventory handling, packing, crating, loading, unloading and distribution services.

How do I discuss the conditions for my products?

Contact our team with your product type, quantity, desired storage conditions and expected duration. The team can discuss suitability and the arrangements available for your requirements.

Can I enquire about storing rice, spices and consumer goods?

Yes. Speak with our team about dry warehousing for bagged rice, packaged spices and other FMCG. Share the product, packaging, quantity, intended storage duration and dispatch needs so the team can confirm suitability. Temperature-controlled storage is discussed separately for goods that require it.

Who should I contact for dry storage?

Email drystorage@bigfootindia.in for dry storage enquiries, or call +91 73387 82692 to speak with our team.
